received_works.body:
Hello! I really love previous art you did for me and I would be happy if you can draw my original characters this time!

Sakari, 24yo, 179cm. He's knight of royal guard, Quite depressed because he feels guilty about his past. Looking for redemption he joined army. For some reason people really likes him even with his pessimistic nature, and that overwhelms him, because he's scared of entering any new relationships. Quite a drinker, sad, but always trying to do his best.

Arinelle, 19yo, 169cm, water mage. Girl that fell in love with him, try to support him, but he still don't want to open too much. She is still his best friend. She also has tragic past, but in contrary she was able to overcome dark past (her village was set on fire).

Einar - 27yo, 184cm, diplomat, visiting Sakari and Arin country because of work, mysterious and flirtatious, smug, really confident. Caught interest in both of them, like to tease other two.

They mostly spend time in local tavern or library. But I will be happy with any other setting! 
Thank you!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1OVB8IEInTmeG1GMrVZs6Pzre50bvupt2

Hello Sensei! I love your art and would like to request a group drawing. I hope it's okay to ask for so many characters, but please feel free to cancel if it’s too much! I hope the amount is enough.

▶ I'd like an elegant group picture of my OCs, similar to this example. I can imagine something with a mansion theme as a background.
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1PcIDyqrkK-LDwHDjy2GlgACt-zygAVbl

Expressions and poses are up to you, and please arrange them however you feel works best. But please do not change their design!

▶ Here’s some basic info about the family:

1. Blue-haired man with glasses, the husband and head of the family. He’s the Count. If possible, please have him holding a walking cane.
2. Blonde woman, the first wife. She’s kindhearted and the mother of the son.
3. Long blue-haired woman, the second wife. A beautiful woman married to the Count due to complicated family reasons.
4. Blue-haired young man, the elder son of the first wife. He has a proud personality.
5. Blue-haired young girl, the younger daughter of the second wife. She has a calm personality.

It would be an honor if you accept this request. Thank you so much in advance, and have a wonderful day!

▶ Character Reference:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aA2-yt9uWHQ40UHcmhWT7-yBoPMiStze

Hello! Your artwork is amazing! I would love it if you could draw a group of four vtubers!
I would like the four of them to be taking a boat ride together. The boat should be on the smaller side. Mikan (The girl with orange hair) should be driving the boat. The other three girls should be looking around and enjoying the view.

The girls may want to use the artwork for SNS or thumbnails, so please decline if that is not okay. Thank you so much!

Characters:
Hexa (Green Hair): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1o8cs5LLvY6s0YsCt8kG5BltTN0VmZqoy
Mikan (Orange Hair): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1f-d6J3Z5Z3W29i-QgCWQVXV0fohrdKJy
Aruru (Blonde Hair): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1L6JqMfgxfazQ2YSMmno1FHx2-a8ZXYfC
Nano (Black Hair): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1T_LSqhQKs6E7kCbBV-aBBpvjztzSc0IT

Thank you so much for accepting my previous request! I really love your style and how you portray the characters interacting. 

Kesu is a Ruddy Shelduck demihuman/harpy that is 171 CM. Miu is a Black Nile spiny mouse demihuman and 164 CM. 

Both characters reside in an Ancient Egyptian themed region. They are both very close companions, and enjoy traveling on their reed boat. If possible, I would like such a background from the point of view on the boat with the reed and palm Nilo river in their background.

Please appeal if the amount is insufficient for the request. Thank you so much for your consideration!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1YVZblztJjlQXDOqCHxHbH3eudedKlaRP

はじめまして!
先生のイラストの色の使い方はとても雰囲気があって好きです！もしよろしければ、2人のキャラクターがいる作品をお願いしたいです。

白虎
白髪
179cm
よく笑い、挑発的で、よくこっそりストリートファイトに参加している。
野良猫に似ている

愛染
ダークブルーの髪
190cm
自信家で、短気で、威圧的な表情をしている。気性が荒いながらも、自分の行動を管理しようと努力している。

仲が良いというより喧嘩が多い、まるでずる賢い猫と警戒心の強い犬のような愛憎劇を繰り広げるが、それでもお互いを強く思い合っている。ポーズや表情は自由に描いてください！

ご検討ありがとうございました！ふさわしくない場合は、お気軽に辞退またはアピールしてください ^O^/

Thank you so much for the gorgeous art last time! I love it a lot. If you would like to draw them again, it would be cute if Theo had caught Flynn to protect him from falling, or protected him from an attack. https://toyhou.se/4518315.theo?key=ogq0Z3cVsCDlliT / https://toyhou.se/9130384.flynn?key=hfJnZk3GxURBOuT 
Thank you!

Hello! I really adore your art style, and want to request a drawing of my characters, Tristan and Alois.

Tristan (182):
- God of order and equilibrium
- Loyal dog, protector
- Motifs: Chinese dragons, wolves, black holes, eclipses, eight-pointed stars, night.
* Please note: He has scars all over his body, including on his neck, hands, and on the corner of his left eye. He has 4 piercings in his left ear and 2 piercings in his right ear.

Alois (188):
- God of chaos and origination
- Quiet, calm
- Motifs: Western dragons, comets, supernova, fallen angels, light.
* Please note: He has the same earring on both sides. His hair ribbon is pale iridescent.

They are lovers who promise to find each other in every universe. I hope you are able to draw freely and have fun with the illustration.

Thank you for reading and considering my request! I hope you have a wonderful day! ٩(｡•́‿•̀｡)۶

Reference images: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1uZmjMY7INo7A9qeYJqJhR8j0zWNXaocF?usp=drive_link

Good day Pepe,

I really enjoy your illustrations and style and would like to request a scene of my OCs Thea and Hedylogos together. 

They are both very close and enjoy the company of each other, and naturally, Hedylogos is always sweet talking Thea at every opportunity he can. They can either be found in the vicinity of the Temple of Aphrodite, or in gardens/natural settings enjoying the company and natural beauty.

They are in a Greco-Roman Ancient/Fantasy setting. Thea is 193 CM Tall. Hedylogos is 180 CM.

Thank you so much for your consideration!

Please appeal if the amount needs to be adjusted for the level of detail.

https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1BSLZJdt7lagwEn41-gNnPOmmyam5SAK3

Hello! I love your work. If you have interest, I would love a drawing of these two characters traveling together. https://toyhou.se/4518315.theo?key=ogq0Z3cVsCDlliT / https://toyhou.se/9130384.flynn?key=hfJnZk3GxURBOuT 
Thank you for your consideration!

Hello, your art is so pretty!! I would love it if you drew a scene of my two characters who are a couple!

Character (A): https://toyhou.se/93891.lacie/gallery
Name: Lacie
Female, 5'2" / 158 cm
She’s a calm and graceful mage who uses swirling and sparkling icy magic.

Character (B): https://toyhou.se/20876806.soren/gallery
Name: Soren
Male, 6'0" / 183 cm
He’s a confident and outgoing magic knight who uses water magic. He has wolf ears, and the blue diamonds in his design are gemstones.

In their relationship, Lacie (A) is the more reserved and shy one while Soren (B) is warmer and more energetic. 

Please feel free to draw them in any setting and composition! Thank you so much!!

Hi! I love your artwork. I wanted to get a drawing with two characters.

Marcel ♂ (180cm) - Blonde hair. A noble king. He is kind and patient, and is a clever and gentle ruler. He has ice magic and has a rapier. He views Beyan very highly, even when others disagree. Beyan brings out a playful and expressive side of him. His motifs are: sun, moon, metal, ice, and dawn. He has freckles and a circlet crown.

Beyan ♂ (178cm) - Brown hair. He was a hero in his youth, but now he is viewed as a villain. He is sly, confident, and dramatic. He has fire magic. The flames are red, purple, and black. His braid is optional. He often teases Marcel, and can be very gentle towards him. His motifs are: sun, moon, fire, smoke, and stars.

They are childhood friends and later become lovers. They have a very warm and gentle love, and dance and laugh together. They have matching red crystals (Marcel’s hair tie and Beyan’s hand). 

Thank you!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ujpyXqWMb0xo-0zzdCnnL3tVMyZgtQeG?usp=sharing

Hi there, I'm fascinated by your works! Can I request an illustration for my original characters?

The slime girl called Vita is an adventurer using bow and arrow as her weapon, she's a kind and cute girl, but also a bit childish and tsundere.
The male called Zealour owns a magic shop. He always seems nice and gentle, takes care of Vita but also likes to tease her. He is actually a silver dragon in human form, good at ice magic.

It's medieval fantasy setting. Please feel free to draw! Maybe the images from reference folder "Commissions together" can also provide you some ideas.

Please sign on a separate layer in the .psd file if possible.
Thank you so much, but if you don’t like it, please feel free to cancel.

https://sta.sh/225m1nh2zz3x

ぺぺ様、はじめまして！ツイッターでイラストを楽しく拝見させて頂きました。素敵な絵柄に惹かれて、可能ならば自キャラを依頼したいと思っております。

【依頼内容】
キャラ参照は下記のURLをご覧ください。南東アジアの様なトロピカル島国に旅をしていて、凸凹コンビで喧嘩すればするほど仲がいい、親友家族恋人相棒のお2人です。一緒に未知か禁じられた廃墟や遺跡を探索している、所謂トゥームレイダーの様な存在です。褐色肌の子は楽天家でお喋りなタイプ、黒髪の子は不器用でクールな性格。対照的な2人ですが、「一緒にいれば自分の世界はどんどん広がっていく」様な関係性です。

【テーマ】
・可能ならば、「旅」のテーマの一枚をお願い致します。トロピカルな設定やモチーフに限らず、お好きな世界観をご自由に描いてください！
・一緒に遺跡や街を探索するか、キャンプするか、旅先を決めようとしているか、シチュエーションは何でも構いません。
・新しい世界に訪れて沢山な不思議なものと人々を触れて、色鮮やかで楽しい雰囲気な一枚をお願い致します。
・「夏、海原、異国、地平線、民族風」のモチーフをどちらでもご自由に使って大丈夫です。
・ポーズや構図は他は何でも構いませんので、お気軽に描いてください！

依頼内容に何か難しい点か問題点があれば、お気になさらずこの依頼をキャンセルしてください。ご検討のほど、何卒よろしくお願いします。
